title: Ethiopian churches keep the Book of Enoch in their canon

tellings.quote: In fact in the fourth around the 4th century uh AD the Tawaho Orthodox Christians and the beta Israel Jew Jewish community in Ethiopia incorporated the book of Enoch into their canon.

plain: Around the 4th century AD, the Tewahedo Orthodox Christians and the Beta Israel Jewish community of Ethiopia are said to have added the Book of Enoch, an ancient Jewish text about angels coming down to live among people, to their official scriptures. A guest named Tim Alberino tells Michels this without naming a source, though he relies on R. H. Charles's English translation of the book, which the record dates to 1917. He mentions it to show that one ancient tradition still treats the text as holy.
